Rishi — thanks for the follow-up and for keeping the draft tight. We reviewed the materials and can confirm the following approvals, subject to the attached signed letter (Clearline-approval-letter-signed.pdf):

- Clearline grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the one-page implementation vignette on redwood.com and to use Clearline logo in sales collateral and deck PDF downloads.
- The approved quote shall read exactly as below (for attribution to Laura Jennings, VP Product):
  "Redwood Inference helped us cut inference time in half while improving care-quality metrics."

- Required attribution language to include under the vignette: "Clearline Health is a customer of Redwood Inference. Use of Clearline name and logo is by permission."

Attached: Clearline-approval-letter-signed.pdf (pdf, 12KB) — executed by Clearline Legal counsel.

Please confirm you will add the exact approved quote and the attribution language to the final vignette and share the final PDF link when ready.
